inputs.name: GithubGrantService.constructor.options
inputs.description: The collaborators and clock the service runs on: the GitHub app config, the GitHub API adapter, the `githubStates` and `grants` stores, the secrets helper, the public `origin` that the callback URL is built from as `${origin}/api/github/callback`, and `now`, which returns epoch milliseconds. The constructor keeps them as given and checks none of them.

inputs.name: GithubGrantService.begin.session
inputs.description: The signed-in session that starts the flow. `begin` records its `idHash`, its `actor.id` and the actor's current grant generation with the new state, and it does not check the session's expiry or revocation.

inputs.name: GithubGrantService.complete.session
inputs.description: The session that completes the flow, which must be the one `begin` recorded: its `idHash` and `actor.id` have to equal the stored state's. `complete` does not check the session's expiry or revocation.

inputs.name: GithubGrantService.complete.input
inputs.description: The `code` and `state` values GitHub returned to the callback. `state` is hashed and claimed once, so an unknown, expired or already used state is refused, and `code` is exchanged together with the PKCE verifier stored for that state.

inputs.name: GithubGrantService.status.actor
inputs.description: The signed-in actor whose GitHub status is read. Only `actor.id` is used, to look up that actor's stored grant, and an expired grant counts as no grant.

inputs.name: GithubGrantService.disconnect.actor
inputs.description: The actor whose GitHub connection is removed. Only `actor.id` is used: the stored tokens are erased and a tombstone is left, so a connection or rotation still in flight cannot write back.

inputs.name: GithubGrantService.userToken.actor
inputs.description: The actor whose GitHub user token is requested. Only `actor.id` is used, to find the stored grant and to open its sealed token, which is bound to that id and opens for no other actor.

outputs.name: STATE_TTL
outputs.description: The lifetime of a GitHub authorization state: 10 minutes, as `10 * 60 * 1000` milliseconds. `begin` stores each state with an expiry of the current time plus this value, and `complete` claims a state only while it is unexpired.

outputs.name: GRANT_TTL
outputs.description: The lifetime of a connected GitHub grant: 30 days, as `30 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000` milliseconds. `complete` sets a new grant's `expiresAt` to its creation time plus this value, rotation keeps that expiry, and the service treats a grant past it as no grant.

outputs.name: REFRESH_LEASE
outputs.description: How long one caller may hold the right to rotate a grant's tokens: 30 seconds, as `30 * 1000` milliseconds. `refresh` requests a lease until the current time plus this value, and rotated tokens are stored only for the holder of that lease.

outputs.name: GithubGrantService.begin
outputs.description: The GitHub authorize URL for the browser to open. It carries the app's client id, the callback `redirect_uri`, a new random `state` and the S256 `code_challenge`; the PKCE verifier stays on the server, sealed for the session, and only a keyed hash of the state is stored.

outputs.name: GithubGrantService.complete
outputs.description: Resolves with no value once the grant is stored for the session's actor, which requires the generation that `begin` recorded to still be current. A refused connection rejects with an `AuthFailure` instead.

outputs.name: GithubGrantService.status
outputs.description: The actor's GitHub status. `configured` is always true for this service, `connected` is true only while a live grant exists, and `login` is that grant's GitHub login, or null when there is none.

outputs.name: GithubGrantService.disconnect
outputs.description: Resolves with no value once the actor's grant is revoked and tombstoned. The revocation is unconditional, so the result does not say whether a grant existed.

outputs.name: GithubGrantService.userToken
outputs.description: The actor's GitHub user access token: the stored one while its expiry is more than a minute away or unknown, otherwise a token this call rotated or, after a lost rotation race, the token now in force. A rejection means no token was returned.

errors.name: AuthFailure
errors.description: Thrown with code `github-not-connected` when the state is unknown, expired, already claimed or bound to another session or actor, when GitHub's token or user response is refused or invalid, when the generation has moved, or when the actor has no usable grant. Thrown with code `github-unavailable` when a GitHub API call hits an outage, rate limit, redirect, network failure or unreadable body, or when a lost rotation race leaves a grant whose token has expired or is within a minute of expiring.
